summary: Official repository has no tag or release; authority is pinned to an immutable commit and tree.
Lanzhou.png and a credited AJbook.cls fragment are CC BY-SA 3.0 exceptions to the principal CC BY 4.0 work.
Upstream build is not toolchain/font/date locked. Windows functional replay produced 446 pages versus official 445.
Li contains 161 active top-level exercises, 268 active items including subparts, and 51 hints but no answer or solution manual; the commented chapter10.tex:1471 item remains excluded.
Official PDF is untagged and the source supplies no HTML/EPUB or diagram alt-text surface.
The interrupted prelude candidate was fully source-order audited, repaired, built, visually checked, backend-bound, and admitted as Unit 001.

Pinned source date and PGF seed yield 21/21 pixel-identical replay renders, but XeTeX serializes non-visible PDF container bytes differently across output directories; bit-identical PDFs are not claimed.

Before any selected CRing unit is translated or published, resolve four empty-reference calls, adjudicate five placeholders, pin dependencies, provenance any original bridge, and complete clean-build/all-page/rights QA.

Unit 002 initially inherited the Chinese reading-box label from AJbook.cls; a target-only Indonesian interface wrapper corrected the rendered label while preserving the frozen upstream class byte-for-byte.

Unit 003 exposed Chinese theorem-family headings and standalone print-only blank versos. The shared target-only interface now localizes environment headings, and the Unit 002/003 digital drivers reflow without blank versos while preserving upstream AJbook.cls and complete-book print behavior.

chapter1.tex:206 says every class of ordinals has a minimal element but omits the necessary nonempty hypothesis explicitly present in referenced Theorem prop:On-wellorder. Unit 004 restores 'tak kosong' in Indonesian and must record this as an editorial correction, not silently attribute the added condition to upstream prose.

The first Unit 004 candidate used a redundant Chinese parenthetical author form whose CID mapping was unavailable to Poppler on this host. The target cover now retains the complete Latin author attribution without the redundant parenthetical; final MuPDF and Poppler renders show no missing glyph.

Unit 003 initially lacked portable glyph coverage for intentional Chinese bibliography metadata and retained nonstandard Lemma/back-reference interface text. The corrected reader uses bundled Noto CJK, Indonesian Lema and back-reference strings, and passes 11/11 replay plus all-page MuPDF/Poppler review.

chapter1.tex:379 reverses the historical roles of Goedel and Cohen in continuum-hypothesis independence. Unit 005 states the standard attributions accurately and records O013-LI-U005-COR-001 rather than silently inheriting the error.

chapter1.tex:304 tacitly replaces an injection by its left composition when replacing Y by g(Y). Unit 005 makes the composition explicit and records O013-LI-U005-CLR-001 without changing the normalized mathematics sequence.

Verified Unit 005 content is preserved at local commit ba4bf6f8f6f62adc95b9057f6a6baadf41f8a347, but GitHub rejects HTTPS push because the configured account is suspended. Two user-provided PAT candidates were unusable, SSH has no key, and the available browser session is signed out. Retry only after authentication state changes; continue source-order translation meanwhile.
chapter1.tex:465 misspells the English index gloss as 'cumulative hierachy'. Unit 006 corrects it to 'cumulative hierarchy' and records O013-LI-U006-COR-001 rather than silently inheriting the typo.

The first Unit 006 reader rendered the inherited Chinese bibliography label '刊于:'. The final target-only bibliography interface uses Indonesian 'Dalam:' and passes all-page MuPDF/Poppler inspection with zero Han residue.

Unit 006 is preserved at local commit 7d66166853257c32d54d8e3499e85cd77a2daeec, but the authorized push again received GitHub's account-suspension 403. Units 005-006 remain queued for one push and anonymous readback after authentication state changes; translation continues at Unit 007.

chapter1.tex:519 tells the reader to take delta to be the well-ordered tail set {xi: alpha <= xi < beta}, which is generally not itself a von Neumann ordinal. Unit 007 takes delta to be that tail's order type and records O013-LI-U007-COR-001 rather than silently inheriting the type error.

The first short Unit 007 reader devoted a full page to a sparse print-style contents surface. The admitted four-page digital reader omits that sparse surface and empty bibliography/index surfaces while retaining chapter/exercise PDF outline navigation and every source exercise/hint.

Backend schema v1.1.0 lacks first-class exercise, subpart, and hint arrays and requires their scalar counts to remain zero. Unit 007 preserves the true 6/6/6 topology through ordered exercise sections, deterministic subpart/hint UUIDv5 entities linked to parents, and live topology/QA gates; migrate losslessly when the shared schema exposes learner surfaces.

The user confirmed GitHub suspended the account after VPN use and filed a support ticket. Do not retry until the user reports restoration. Zenodo concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22059759 now preserves verified coherent releases independently of GitHub availability.

Zenodo exposes one record-level license although the package has three controlling component licenses. Version 0.1.0 therefore uses Other (Open), while description, notes, LICENSES.md, RIGHTS_COMPONENTS.csv, source notices, and reader covers preserve CC BY 4.0, CC BY-SA 3.0, and OFL 1.1 without flattening them.

Unit 008 cites later whole-book destinations that are absent from the standalone reader. A frozen AUX witness preserves Section 1.5, Section 2.7, and Proposition 2.8.2, while the empty external URL deliberately suppresses clickable links rather than pointing readers to a missing PDF. The references remain printed and correct; the three corresponding hyperref warnings are expected.

The inherited XeLaTeX pipeline emits an untagged PDF. Unit 008 keeps its comparative table text-native, full-width, and legible and adds a paired linear-reading semantics record in the modular backend, but this does not constitute tagged-PDF conformance.

Independent audit found that the first Unit 008 backend inherited Unit 007's chapter1.tex principal-rights binding and that its generator trusted summary markers without cross-binding live PDF/log identity and page count. The generator now binds chapter2.tex and verifies artifact/log bytes and hashes plus four-way page-count agreement; stale-summary and page-drift negative tests are refused. Canonical JSON and CSV were regenerated before commit or Zenodo publication.

Figshare offers one article-level license and cannot faithfully represent the linked release's CC BY 4.0, CC BY-SA 3.0, and OFL 1.1 component rights. No work files were copied. Article 33314766 is a fileless CC0 metadata record whose description limits CC0 to metadata and links the exact Zenodo release; anonymous readback verifies zero files and preserved rights prose.

The historical v1 metadata-only route did not satisfy the later explicit reader-first work-item instruction. The same article was corrected without creating a duplicate: v2 publishes the best 83-page reader first plus one compact source/backend archive, component LICENSES, manifest, and checksums. The principal item is CC BY 4.0 and its description/package preserve the CC BY-SA 3.0 and OFL 1.1 exceptions. All five anonymous downloads match SHA-256.

The user reports GitHub reinstated. Exact public repository, raw README, and smart-fetch endpoints return HTTP 200 rather than suspension 404. Resume a narrow corpus-local push and public readback; do not stage the unreviewed Unit 009 candidate in the admitted Unit 008 publication boundary.

Restored GitHub accepted the narrow accumulated push. Remote main is 37fa96e945ce150eb3897a2c1c37c7beb9aa5603; admitted content/receipts are bound at bdc8fcfc24593196bc94f0d82a79ecfafd026b00. Anonymous raw SHA-256 readback passed for the Unit 005-008 PDF/backend surfaces checked, admitted Unit 008 target, combined reader, README, and receipts. Unreviewed Unit 009 bytes were not staged.

The power-set example is a functor on Set but the source writes Hom_C in its representability isomorphism. Unit 013 uses Hom_Set, preserves the mathematical intent, and binds correction O013-LI-U013-COR-001 in the structure and admission evidence.

The source says Eilenberg-MacLane spaces represent homology functors; the standard representability statement is for cohomology. Unit 013 uses fungtor kohomologi and binds correction O013-LI-U013-COR-002 in the structure and admission evidence.
The adjunction example writes the natural isomorphism component as \varphi_{VW}, which collapses the two object indices. Unit 014 uses \varphi_{V,W} and binds the repair as O013-LI-U014-COR-001.

Finite-dimensional linear duality is contravariant, but the source states the duality equivalence without the opposite category on its domain. Unit 014 adds the required superscript op and binds the repair as O013-LI-U014-COR-002.
The same duality display uses Vect(k)_f although the surrounding source convention is Vect_f(k). Unit 014 restores the established notation and binds the repair as O013-LI-U014-COR-003.

The source indexes counit components by objects of C1 even though the counit has codomain-side components. Unit 014 indexes (\varepsilon_Y) by Y in Obj(C2) and binds the repair as O013-LI-U014-COR-004.
The source writes the second adjunction tuple with the prime after the comma as (F', G,' ...). Unit 015 restores (F', G', ...) and binds the repair as O013-LI-U015-COR-001.

The second TikZ picture refers to midpoint node A1 even though only local node A2 is defined there, risking an accidental cross-picture reference. Unit 015 uses A2 and binds the repair as O013-LI-U015-COR-002.

The source duplicates p_i as a prose prefix immediately before the projective-limit arrow already labelled p_i. Unit 016 removes only the redundant prefix and binds the typographic repair as O013-LI-U016-COR-001.

The proof constructs the right iterated-limit term first but the following source prose calls it the left term. Unit 016 swaps only the prose order, preserves the displayed formula, and binds the repair as O013-LI-U016-COR-002.
The coproduct/product definition leaves i free in varinjlim alpha(i) and varprojlim beta(i). Unit 016 adds the explicit i in I binders and binds the notation repair as O013-LI-U016-COR-003.
A diagram leg with domain F alpha(i) is labelled upstream by the map from alpha(j). Unit 017 restores alpha(i) on that leg and binds the repair as O013-LI-U017-COR-001.
The source calls an arbitrary coproduct in Ab a direct product, although it is the direct sum. Unit 017 uses jumlah langsung and binds the mathematical repair as O013-LI-U017-COR-002.
The preservation diagram quantifies j in Obj(i), but i is not a category and the diagram is indexed by I. Unit 017 uses Obj(I) and binds the repair as O013-LI-U017-COR-003.

Two Hom-sets involving F-images and beta(j) are typed upstream over C1 even though both arguments lie in C2. Unit 017 uses Hom_C2 in both places and binds the repairs together as O013-LI-U017-COR-004.

Two limit-to-component projections are styled as surjections upstream, but arbitrary component morphisms need not extend to compatible cones. Unit 017 uses ordinary arrows and binds the repair as O013-LI-U017-COR-005.

The source asserts existence in C2 of varprojlim beta although beta is a C1-valued diagram; preservation concerns the image diagram. Unit 017 uses varprojlim(F beta) and binds the repair as O013-LI-U017-COR-006.
The source redundantly introduces Bbbk as a field by saying ‘let the field Bbbk be a field.’ Unit 018 removes only the duplicated predicate and binds the editorial repair as O013-LI-U018-COR-001.

The source introduces the forgetful functor Set_bullet to Set but then asks for adjoints of U without naming that functor U. Unit 018 explicitly binds U to the displayed forgetful functor and records the repair as O013-LI-U018-COR-002.

The source diagram has Z tensor ((1 tensor X) tensor Y) at its lower-right vertex although every adjacent vertex and arrow requires the monoidal unit object. The Unit 019 candidate uses the monoidal-unit macro at that position and records the mathematical repair as O013-LI-U019-COR-001; canonical admission remains pending.

A delegated read-only audit malformed a PowerShell path array for one rg invocation, so rg fell back to the large workspace cwd and performed one unintended broad text scan. The agent disclosed it immediately. It made no writes and ran no Git command; all later audit reads used explicit LiteralPath targets. No artifact, source, backend, control, or publication byte was changed. The audit itself otherwise passed. Future delegated checks must receive exact paths and avoid array interpolation that can erase path arguments.

The source writes H/N intersection H where the second isomorphism theorem requires H/(N intersection H). Unit026 parenthesizes the kernel in active and preserved commented occurrences under O013-LI-U026-COR-001; exact topology and mathematics gates pass.
The source introduces phi but composes varphi for the same homomorphism. Unit026 uses varphi consistently under O013-LI-U026-COR-002; exact command and formula gates pass.

The source states an inverse formula without restricting it to quotient groups, although arbitrary quotient monoid elements need not be invertible. Unit026 restricts the formula to the group case under O013-LI-U026-COR-003.

The source cyclic-subgroup order statement does not exclude n=0 and can report negative n/m as an order. Unit026 gives absolute order for n nonzero and handles the n=0 infinite and trivial cases under O013-LI-U026-COR-004.

The source allows D=1 in a quadratic-ring direct-sum statement, but Q(sqrt(1)) is not quadratic and the displayed decomposition fails. Unit042 excludes D=1 under O013-LI-U042-COR-001.
The Gaussian-prime discussion omits the equation relating conjugate primes. Unit042 inserts bar(p)=u p under O013-LI-U042-COR-002.
The global content-multiplicativity statement contains an unused polynomial quantifier. Unit042 removes it under O013-LI-U042-COR-003.
The source treats content classes as if elements could be multiplied without choosing representatives. Unit042 makes the representative choice explicit under O013-LI-U042-COR-004.
The multivariable content construction lacks a typed definition. Unit042 defines it by coefficientwise valuation minima under O013-LI-U042-COR-005.

The gcd claim is not valid for arbitrary pairs including zero, although the generated-ideal identity is. Unit042 qualifies gcd to nonzero elements while retaining the unconditional ideal equality under O013-LI-U042-COR-006.
Eisenstein's criterion omits 1 <= k <= n; k=n=0 with f=1 is a counterexample and the proof needs p dividing a0. Unit042 adds the hypothesis under O013-LI-U042-COR-007.

The source universal-property statement assigns phi the undefined codomain M although the diagram and componentwise proof force the product. Unit027 restores codomain product_i M_i under O013-LI-U027-COR-001.

The source applies the regular-polygon interpretation to all n >= 0. Unit027 restricts only that geometric interpretation to n >= 3 while retaining the wider algebraic semidirect-product construction under O013-LI-U027-COR-002.
An earlier Indonesian phrase called the restricted conjugation action inner on N, which need not hold. Unit027 says it is the restriction of an adjoint automorphism under O013-LI-U027-TR-001.
